item.title: Custom Printed Corrugated Shipping Mailer Box for E-Commerce
item.description:
Product Overview

Custom printed corrugated shipping mailer boxes engineered for e-commerce fulfillment — the workhorse of direct-to-consumer shipping. Manufactured by Guangdong Bincai Color Printing Co., Ltd. in our 10,000 sqm Foshan facility, these mailers combine corrugated strength with high-quality flexo or offset printing, turning your shipping box into a branded unboxing experience. Available in single-wall, double-wall, and self-sealing configurations.

Manufacturing Specifications

  • Flute types: E-flute (1.2mm, premium retail), B-flute (3.2mm, general shipping), BC double-wall (6.5mm, heavy-duty)
  • Board grades: Kraft liner (125-200gsm), white top kraft, test liner, recycled
  • Printing: Flexo 1-3 color or offset litho-laminated for photo-quality graphics
  • Die-cutting: Bobst rotary and flatbed die-cutters, ±1mm precision
  • Daily output: 1.5 million boxes across all production lines
  • Adhesives: Hot-melt and cold water-based, compliant with EU REACH and US FDA

Customization Options

  • Size: Custom any dimensions, from 150mm × 100mm × 30mm to 600mm × 400mm × 200mm
  • Closure: Self-locking bottom, tear strip opening, tuck-top with dust flaps, crash-lock auto-bottom
  • Wall construction: Single-wall (E/B-flute), double-wall (BC-flute), triple-wall for pallet loads
  • Surface: Brown kraft (natural), white top liner (premium), coated white (photo-quality print)
  • Printing: Your full brand design — logo, product image, care instructions, QR codes
  • Features: Perforated tear strip, integrated return label, finger holes, ventilation holes
  • Inserts: Corrugated partitions, die-cut foam, molded pulp trays

Applications

Purpose-built for: subscription box services, e-commerce apparel shipping, cosmetics and skincare fulfillment, electronics shipping, book and media mailers, food delivery kits, direct-to-consumer brands, Amazon FBA-compliant packaging, and retail-ready shelf packaging.

item.title: Eco-Friendly Kraft Corrugated Mailer Box with Custom Print
item.description:
Description

Our eco-friendly kraft corrugated mailer box with custom print combines sustainability with branded impact for e-commerce shipping, subscription boxes, and direct-to-consumer fulfillment. Each mailer is manufactured in our 10,000 sqm Foshan production hub, where 22 years of packaging experience and advanced offset printing technology deliver consistent, high-quality results at scale.

item.title: White Corrugated Shipping Box for Cosmetic Apparel Delivery
item.description:
Premium white corrugated shipping box engineered for cosmetic and apparel e-commerce delivery — by Guangdong Bincai Color Printing Co., Ltd. (founded 2003), a 22-year full-chain packaging manufacturer. 10,000 sqm factory with KBA 1050 4-color offset and Heidelberg 7+1 UV presses, integrated corrugated production line. Daily output 1.5 million boxes. ISO 9001 & FSC certified. Custom sizes, branded printing, and ISTA-tested structural integrity.

Applications

  • Cosmetic and skincare product e-commerce shipping
  • Apparel, fashion, and clothing brand mailer packaging
  • Beauty subscription box monthly delivery packaging
  • Fragrance and perfume bottle protective shipping
  • Luxury fashion accessory (scarves, ties, belts) mailer boxes
  • Direct-to-consumer (DTC) brand branded outbound packaging
  • Boutique retail restocking and wholesale order fulfillment
  • Influencer PR kit and media sample mailing boxes

Customization Options

  • Flute Profile: B-flute (3mm, crush resistant for heavy items), C-flute (4mm, all-purpose), E-flute (1.5mm, premium print surface), or double-wall BC-flute (7mm, heavy-duty)
  • Board Grade: Kraft liner (brown), white top kraft liner, white duplex (coated print surface), or full bleached white throughout
  • Printing: Flexographic (1–4 color) for cost-effective branding; offset litho-laminated (full CMYK + Pantone) for premium print quality
  • Structure: Self-locking crash-lock bottom, tuck-top with dust flaps, roll-end tuck-top (RETT), or telescoping two-piece design
  • Closure: Integrated tear strip for tool-free opening; adhesive strip with release liner; perforated zip-open panel
  • Coatings: Aqueous coating, UV spot varnish, matte/gloss lamination, or soft-touch coating for premium unboxing
  • Add-Ons: Die-cut handle, ventilation holes, tamper-evident seals, QR code printing, inside printing (brand messaging or return instructions)
  • Size Range: Compact 150×100×50mm (single cosmetics item) to 600×400×400mm (bulk apparel order)

Production Specifications

  • KBA Rapida 105 4-color: Offset litho-laminated printing at 15,000 sheets/hour for premium white-top graphics
  • Heidelberg Speedmaster CD 102 7+1 UV: Specialty coatings, metallic inks, and instant curing
  • Corrugator: In-line single-face and double-backer production for B/C/E-flute board; FSC-certified paper rolls
  • Die-Cutting: Bobst SPO flatbed die-cutter — ±0.5mm registration on corrugated; custom cutting dies
  • Folder-Gluer: Bobst Masterfold automatic — crash-lock, 4/6-corner, and auto-bottom configurations
  • Tear Strip: Hot-melt applied reinforced tear tape — 3mm or 6mm width; positioned at specified distance from edge
  • Lead Time: 7–12 working days for standard configurations; 12–18 days with offset litho-lamination
  • Daily Capacity: 100,000–300,000 corrugated mailers per day

Quality & Testing

  • ISO 9001:2015 certified — quality gates at flute formation, lamination, die-cutting, gluing, and final inspection
  • FSC Chain-of-Custody — certified sustainable fiber throughout the supply chain
  • Edge Crush Test (ECT): 32–44 lb/in (B-flute single-wall) per TAPPI T-811 for stacking strength
  • Bursting Strength: 200–275 PSI (single-wall) per TAPPI T-810 for puncture resistance
  • Box Compression Test (BCT): Tested per ISTA 1A/3A — adequate for 6-high warehouse stacking
  • Drop Test: ISTA 1A — 10-drop sequence from 760mm (30") with no structural failure or product damage
  • Tear Strip: Consistent tear initiation and propagation — tested at 100% on-line
  • Print Registration: ±0.5mm on flexo; ±0.2mm on offset litho-laminated
  • Moisture Content: 6.5–8.5% per TAPPI T-412 for dimensional stability in shipping
  • Free pre-production sample — 5–7 working day turnaround

Factory

  • 22 years of manufacturing excellence since 2003 in Foshan, Guangdong, China
  • 10,000 sqm main factory + 8,000 sqm smart factory (2025)
  • 80+ skilled employees covering corrugated, offset, and finishing departments
  • KBA 1050 4-color + Heidelberg 7+1 UV + Bobst die-cutting + integrated corrugator + automatic folder-gluer
  • In-house corrugated board production — quality-controlled from raw paper roll to finished box
  • Export to 40+ countries with e-commerce packaging as a growth category
  • Daily capacity: 1.5 million boxes total (300,000+ corrugated mailers dedicated)
